crossRefs.note: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.
But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”
I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason…
Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”

translations.web: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”
translations.bsb: So when I was invited, I came without objection. I ask, then, why have you sent for me?”
translations.kjv: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
translations.asv: wherefore also I came without gainsaying, when I was sent for. I ask therefore with what intent ye sent for me.
